about.title: About
about.description: Computer Engineering graduate specializing in Low-Level Systems and Robotics
content: Hello! I'm Amr Eslim, a Computer Engineering graduate based in Berlin, Germany.
I completed my Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering at HTW Berlin in April 2025.
My expertise lies in Embedded Linux, Firmware Development, and High-Performance C++ Applications.
Since August 2026, I have been working as an IoT & Energy Data Project Developer at Gewobag ED, helping connect smart technology with sustainable housing in Berlin.

My Bachelor's thesis on neurobiologically-inspired snake robotics demonstrates my ability to bridge control theory with efficient C/C++ implementation, combining CPG algorithms and real-time constraints.
With a strong background in C/C++, Python, Rust, and Linux Kernel, I build reliable, memory-safe, and efficient solutions for complex technical challenges.
I'm particularly interested in developing autonomous robotics systems and optimizing low-level drivers for next-gen hardware.
Ready to deploy efficient code to production.
